correctness.rationale: The 20-dimensional bidegree-(4,3) space has a rank-nine rational evaluation map. Exhaustive enumeration of all 2047 nonzero kernel forms, exact four-chart Groebner unit-ideal smoothness tests, and the complete action of all 36 ambient transformations give 66 smooth forms and four orbits. Direct F2^n point counts for n=1,...,6 yield four genus-six Weil polynomials; the functional equation determines their remaining coefficients. Independently constructed Cartier matrices have rank and sixth-iterate stable ranks (6,6,5,6), agreeing with mod-two Weil degrees. Exact standalone replay succeeded. The scope is finite and complete, not a sampled proof.

originality.rationale: The first source arXiv:2203.11595 (10-page open-access PDF, relevant theorem and sections inspected) proves minimal bidegree and an example but not the exact Jacobian isogeny or p-rank classification. The later arXiv:2512.02796 (13-page open-access PDF, relevant sections inspected) examines primarily odd-q smooth filling curves and q=3,5 counts, not the four genus-six L polynomials. Explicit synonym, parameter and implication searches found no covering table. The previously determined 66-form count and four orbit sizes are not asserted to be original.
residual_risks: A zeta or isogeny table in unindexed material, specialized finite-field curve databases, or a differently named enumeration may cover these invariants.
Priority judgment relies on accessible inspected primary sources and query results; it is not a proof of global uniqueness.

value.rationale: The genus-six binary minimal filling-curve family is a naturally singled out extremal geometry. Its entire Jacobian isogeny/2-rank/a-number structure, sharp p-rank-five floor, and unique 36-member nonordinary orbit supply useful new arithmetic-geometric information that does not follow from the pre-existing equation count alone.
